plan.title: Comprehensive Government Exam Study Plan (Working Professional)
plan.summary: A 4-week intensive schedule tailored for a 9-to-7 working professional, scheduling daily 2-hour evening study sessions (7:30 PM - 9:30 PM) targeting weak areas like puzzles, reasoning, and English.

weeks.milestone: Complete basic puzzle concepts and take a full SSC CGL mock.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve 10 basic puzzle problems and review seating arrangement rules.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Study family tree notations and solve 15 beginner questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice 20 moderate puzzles focusing on floor and box types.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve 25 coding-based blood relation questions for speed.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Revise core grammar rules and solve 20 practice MCQs.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice 30 synonyms, antonyms, and vocabulary flashcards.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Read 2 editorials and solve 3 reading comprehension passages.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Learn fraction-to-percentage shortcuts and solve 20 basic problems.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Light review of week's formula notes and incorrect mock questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve 25 questions on weighted averages and speed calculation.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take a 30-question mixed reasoning sectional quiz.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take SSC CGL Tier I Full Test 1 and analyze every mistake.

weeks.milestone: Improve English comprehension scores and master arithmetic fundamentals.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice 5 cloze tests and sentence rearrangement exercises.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Tackle 15 advanced scheduling and floor puzzles.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve 30 advanced word problems on percentage increase/decrease.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice complex average grouping and replacement questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice 30 error-spotting questions from previous year exams.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve fill-in-the-blanks and voice change exercises.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Timed drill of 20 complex multi-person blood relation puzzles.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice 30 coding-decoding and direction sense questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Review vocabulary notes and revise arithmetic shortcuts.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Analyze past paper questions where accuracy was low.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Practice 3 lengthy reading comprehension passages.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take IBPS CSA-XVI Prelims Model Test 32 under strict timing.

weeks.milestone: Boost speed in puzzles and sharpen overall exam accuracy.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve 15 high-level seating arrangement and floor puzzles.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Mixed practice of 30 percentage and average problems.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice 5 para jumbles and sentence improvement exercises.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Solve 30 syllogism and inequality questions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Timed test of 40 mixed arithmetic questions.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Revise direct/indirect speech and active/passive rules.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Timed speed drill: 10 puzzle sets in 45 minutes.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Review current affairs and static GK highlights.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Light review of weak topics and formula cheat sheets.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Solve and review previous year shift paper questions.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Speed math drill: multiplication shortcuts and squares.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take SBI Clerk Prelims Model Test 123 and review performance.

weeks.milestone: Simulate real exam pressure and solidify all key concepts.

tasks.activity: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Practice mock review and solve 3 difficult RC passages.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Targeted practice on missed puzzle concepts.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Timed practice of 15 mixed puzzles.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Quick revision of arithmetic formulas and shortcut tricks.
7:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Take IBPS RRB PO Prelims Full Test 1 under exam conditions.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Deep dive into mock test errors and weakness logs.
8:30 PM - 9:30 PM: Final revision of grammar rules and high-yield vocabulary.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Review formula summary sheets and relax before exam day.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Final calm-down reading of key formulas and exam strategy notes.
7:30 PM - 8:30 PM: Review completed mock results and plan next steps.

tips: Prioritize your weakest topics like Puzzles and English Comprehension daily.
Analyze every mock test thoroughly—don't just check scores, review errors.
Stick firmly to your 7:30 PM - 9:30 PM study block after work to maintain consistency.

form.goal: I'm preparing for all government exams so plan a proper schedule to cover all
